summary: The First Den is a forest world centered on Spawn and its home, with lake and creek activities, farms, Mirror Tarn, Garden and Market districts, a royal city/castle and hilltop village. Authored cell scenes combine interactive systems, procedural structure families, animated NPCs and wildlife; the player uses a fire-led bending kit, wolf encounters and camera-relative WoW-style movement with a classic MMO HUD.

places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Spawn/home, Tower Gardens, paired east/west crop farms, orchard and farm props
places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene - west farm barn/windmill, Garden Market south gate and Mossback wolf den/pack

places/main/cells/x-1z-1.scene - Hollow wolf den and alpha pack
places/main/cells/x0z1.scene - Market/royal district, Ember Roost tower, aqueduct, banners and east gate
places/main/cells/x-1z1.scene - Garden Market, rostered gardeners, north gate and Three Squares sign links

scripts/bender.js damage/status/threat writes -> scripts/wolf-pack.js scheduled update -> wolf combat, death/respawn and XP/kills/boss rewards on player

farm-west/windmill state.sails + degPerSec -> scripts/farm-windmill.js update -> rotating sail child; farm builders supply crop, fence, barn, mill and props geometry

scripts/gen/town-square.js + town-kit and town-link.js + town-links.json - civic pieces, lamps, directional posts and named links vary by kind, layout and placed text

migrationNotes: forest-terrain heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main river is at sea level y=0, ground around y=0.5, Spawn clearing near (0,-3).
Keep terrain material IDs, clear/flatten marks and decoration bindings coordinated with scene placements; terrain paths grade/clear sites while scene builders supply visible structures and paving.

Farm roots use feet y=0.5; farm child coordinates and crop strips/fence points are local to parent roots, while config flatten marks use world x/z. Windmill sail is a child pivot; behavior writes its roll from degPerSec.
Mirror Tarn is centered (82,78), water level 0.3 with depth 2.6; shore and Three Squares links in main config, town-links.json and scene signs describe the same routes.

WoW steering records hands in ctx.session.wowHands per entity; camera.state.heading is body heading and camera.state.off orbit. Avoid double-applying A/D turns across player.js and camera.js; humanoid locomotion consumes wowBasis(ctx).

Bender cast timing drives castEnd HUD feedback and castThrow release pose; casting loop/release clips are upper-body masked. wolf-pack no longer pushes casts back on damage, and fireball bolts use the faster fast path.
